items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22
items.q: In fact, we had trumpet player Ray Lopez... we called Ray Lopez the leader. Tom was the manager. I was nobody for that matter, but I'd go around and book the band.

ctx.x: No lessons on anything. In fact, we had trumpet player Ray Lopez, he played the, his cornet, as I call it, because he was short, see. Left handed. Instead of right handed, he put his left hand over the horn and figured that way, left handed. Well, that was his style of playing. But he wasn't taught. The only one that knew how to read a few notes was Gussie Mueller. And he could only read the lead part on top of a piano part. And he'd play that over and we'd catch it just that quick, see, and we'd form our own…
Now what was your first instrument that you took up?
